product_group_name.dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(20,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[product_group_name],
        TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CONSUMER GOODS"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name]),
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "transactions_prior_derived", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
        "bills growth", [bills growth]
    ),
    ABS([revenue Growth]), DESC)
ORDER BY [revenue Growth] DESC
